result.keyword: What's the best CRM for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **HubSpot or Pipedrive**\. They're relatively easy to adopt, don't require a dedicated CRM administrator, and give you a good foundation for managing customers and sales.

However, the best choice depends on whether you're primarily managing sales leads, existing customers, marketing, or the entire customer relationship.

## My top 5 CRM recommendations

![Predictive Customer Intelligence for Financial Services | Predicti](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/iC2IuIJmVm3R9kdyjnBXpJe9EFoFVdsqMo7SD2Ylye71u9qKpVhfB000-F0mvgc8T97y5jTNlo_OlcK3Vnw7CA58icJdEFrhxmAQ_N6phRnAkl550v9l428a7i-pdwyvhpAA2dzygcM34-sdw591sBkt3g_vmQpp-jkgjvCwm2EOISuK-0fFp_-pq6Juyvbf?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. HubSpot**

(Best overall)

Free plan available

- Excellent contact and customer management.
- Sales pipeline, email tracking and follow-up tasks.
- Marketing, sales and customer service tools.
- Easy for non-technical teams to learn.

**Best for\:** Small businesses wanting an all-round CRM that can grow with them.

[HubSpot website](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

---

![Pipedrive Culture | Comparably](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/LL0qs5ZEn5bajHXZMpCmlJ4Q8G8bG-uCRPdMDaugOTZ5M83xr5SdfSJtpaTsU9pV5XZU_j6tdK98aLeb5eQtmf3jAulEyqWXtwu_NCqqantmt4RgTKgW92e5jqAqiwI5Gvz6HoJSFRLf0DV2WCKF0F5we1qdhyYgERFOvFPWSwO__wWT47lukE3R9cSOeuBr?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Pipedrive**

(Best for sales teams)

From approximately A\$19/user/month

- Very clear visual sales pipeline.
- Tracks deals and sales opportunities.
- Follow-up reminders and sales activities.
- Minimal complexity.

**Best for\:** Teams focused on converting enquiries into paying customers.

[Pipedrive website](https://www.pipedrive.com/)

---

![Zoho CRM](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/LZlTcOa6zgeUybNaonLUYvxN4Rtec07eojK_VJhCCLpPe0T64SQj5koJFmf7uNxIuKS3ep2p-U55iR01zZ5xOPcIAKQMCwUzJDvSmehvwhZmKJorvcP26O8MMAUtZ6c2wfHJODrw-pBTUeo0CUTYuV5BaO2qPXq1tygkA2QMwor6q5go-RH9QD52810nB8DV?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho CRM**

(Best value)

Free for up to 3 users; paid from approximately A\$22/user/month

- Highly customisable.
- Good automation capabilities.
- Broad reporting and analytics.
- Integrates with the wider Zoho ecosystem.

**Best for\:** Small businesses wanting lots of functionality without a huge software budget.

[Zoho CRM website](https://www.zoho.com/crm/)

---

![Freshsales Reviews, Pricing, Key Info, and FAQs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/K07S4lupkbqzQ7IJWsbLQDl_aw7G-Q5ck81gT3hTCuqSl43anPhnfDFmDbefUOdxVsjYLm_LYWgGTWI98sFAWedta2QsUixC7OM_PM1s6Y1EuFzTcZSsdi41c8KkyM-mHP8elkKTEPCnO2Il_HO6e_HYAMF4L3eSNfQjDBIzFOFumlny6cGeRX7F_U4CyLr6?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Freshsales**

(Best for communication)

From approximately A\$15/user/month

- Built-in phone capabilities.
- Email and customer communication.
- Sales automation.
- AI-assisted sales tools.

**Best for\:** Teams that spend lots of time calling and following up with prospects.

[Freshsales website](https://www.freshworks.com/crm/sales/)

---

![monday.com Products](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/rL9Bzm932Es-G8eSD-IugxH25VpIFj2GrnbBExwUqA2Nr3S2F-13Q2QUuWHSsw5hSYAN9ENyOY_MTevU9OZtOiwp-cUhvAnLAqY_40r6pFQsW3KxPgFxL3JCosxfn4L6Jfwp2NCZNME-i2pDOLdg2P_TmFE26A6QIif7ztMuqYUxcMfuJMeKmmPBjbxzqwot?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. monday CRM**

(Best for visual workflows)

From approximately A\$19/seat/month

- Highly visual and customisable.
- Sales and customer tracking.
- Task management and team collaboration.
- Connects sales processes with operational workflows.

**Best for\:** Teams wanting CRM and project management in one workspace.

[monday CRM website](https://monday.com/crm)

Indicative Australian pricing based on 2026 comparisons, generally annual billing. Check current plans, taxes and user limits before purchasing. ## My quick comparison

| CRM | Biggest advantage | Main drawback |
|--------|--------|--------|
| HubSpot | All-round functionality | Paid upgrades can get expensive |
| Pipedrive | Simple sales management | Less comprehensive marketing |
| Zoho | Features for the price | More complicated setup |
| Freshsales | Built-in communications | Smaller integration ecosystem |
| monday CRM | Flexible workflows | Can require configuration |


## Let me narrow it down to the best one for your business

I'd like to understand four things\:

**1\. How big is your team?**

---

**2\. What type of business are you running?**

---

**3\. What do you primarily want the CRM to do?**

---

**4\. What's your monthly budget per user?**

---

**Bonus: What software do you currently use?**

I'll use those answers to narrow it down to the best two or three options, including which one I'd actually choose and why.
